coarse.rule: permutation(seed 0) of the train labels; idx[n_tr + val_samples : n_tr + val_samples + limit]

fine.rule: permutation(seed 0) of the train labels; idx[n_tr + val_samples : n_tr + val_samples + limit]

calib.rule: calib_split of each checkpoint (permutation seed 0 of its train list, last val_frac held out, its val_samples skipped), intersected, filtered to the cities, first --calib-limit

meta.protocol: calibration draw split by frame id into a selection half (OFAT + joint grid, argmin of the objective) and a confirmation half (paired bootstrap guard: the best replaces the default only if the interval is below zero); the test draw is scored for the default and the chosen configuration only (headline: their paired change)
meta.cert_confound: cert=weight and cert=uniform go through the weighted-sampling estimators (srt: the package's 4-point DLT loop, sim: its Kabsch similarity loop, fixed trials) instead of cv2's adaptive RANSAC; weight vs uniform isolates the weighting, uniform vs off the estimator swap (se2: same estimator)
not_sweepable: mode thresholds below the cache threshold

fine_centring.note: --passes fine: the fine windows are centred on the caching coarse consensus (reproj=3 target=peak max_modes=all thr=0.008 cert=off solver=se2 ransac=default), not on a swept one
